pages.title: DNA Analyzer
pages.text: Core for the Rod of Deviation. Charge it by scanning the following mobs near you all at the same time: Creeper, Skeleton, Chicken, Cow, and Enderman.

pages.title: Deviation Analyzer
pages.text: Core for the Rod of Super Mutation. Charge it by scanning the following deviated mobs near you all at the same time: Creeper, Skeleton, Shulker, and Enderman.

pages.title: Ultimatum Analyzer
pages.text: Core for the Rod of Ultimatum. Charge it by scanning the following fully super-mutated mobs near you all at the same time: Vex, Stray, Creeper, Witch, Magma Cube, Slime Strider, Slime, Piglin, Skeleton, and Llama.
